articles.title: Shop freezers in seven European countries hit by cyber-attack
articles.description: The temperature of freezers in several shops across Europe reportedly rose to as high as 50C.

articles.title: Fighting returns to Kherson region after longest Ukraine war ceasefire
articles.description: Though unprecedented, the six-day truce has done little to alter the wider trajectory of a war that continues to grinds on.

articles.title: Dutch police offer record €2m reward in hunt for drug lord
articles.description: Jos Leijdekkers has been found guilty in absentia of cocaine smuggling and is believed to be in Sierra Leone.

articles.title: Fake nuclear warnings issued after Ukrainian and Russian air alert apps hacked
articles.description: Neither government has confirmed who was responsible for the cyberattacks on Sunday evening.

articles.title: Israeli strikes in Gaza kill eight including child, hospitals say
articles.description: Five officers from the Hamas-run police have been killed in Khan Younis and three people, including a child, killed in Gaza City, officials say.

articles.title: Armed police start patrols in Sydney after Bondi Beach attack
articles.description: The new police unit is a security measure in response to last year's deadly shooting attack at a Hanukkah festival.

articles.title: India's opposition holds mega rally seeking election chief's resignation
articles.description: Thousands gathered in the heart of delhi, calling for the chief election commissioner to step down.

articles.title: Judge orders Trump administration to stop threatening US election officials
articles.description: The order comes after election officials received letters demanding they set aside the ballots of possible non-citizen voters.

articles.title: 'Everything is destroyed': Hackers target refrigerators in new cyber attacks
articles.description: Cyber hackers have targeted fridges and freezers in supermarkets in several European countries including Ireland – causing temperatures to increase and food to spoil.

articles.title: Man dies and another injured after attack at centre housing migrants
articles.description: A man has died following an attack at a centre housing migrants in Ireland.
